newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise and volume jumps.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise and volume jumps.

text.p: Istanbul gold volume jumped to 830 kilos on Monday from 356 kilos on Friday on physical demand from the free market, despite rising prices, dealers said.

Gold continued to rise to $358.00 an ounce versus Friday's $354.55 following firmer world levels. It also rose dramatically to 1,397,500 lira per gram from the previous 1,386,000 lira, aided by the Turkish lira's continuing weakness against the dollar.

"There was continued physical demand coming from the free market, especially in the morning session. But there is still a shortage of gold being brought onto the market by banks (the main importers) which pushed up the higher," one dealer said.
The lira eased to 121,180 to the dollar against 120,980 on Friday.
Of the total trade, 725 kilos was made in the morning session and 62.7 percent of the total was in dollar terms.
